title: List default profile before named profiles
description: Change h2 profile list ordering so the built-in default profile is always first when present; keep every other profile alphabetically sorted. Add regression coverage.

comments.author: fond-frost
comments.text: Implemented and self-reviewed: h2 profile list now stably promotes the built-in default profile ahead of all named profiles while explicitly sorting the remaining names alphabetically. Added an exact output-order regression test with alpha/default/middle/zeta. Targeted profile-list tests and make check pass.
